text:
Maya: quick async standup — onboarded synth-spanish-v2 to staging. Ran eval suite, saw a surprising drop on translation BLEU and a small increase in hallucination score. Need a quick look on prompt canonicalization and tokenizer settings.

Jon: can you paste the numbers and which eval set?

Maya: sure, gist of failing metrics:
```
set: es-news-synth-v1
BLEU: 12.3 -> 9.1
hallucination_rate: 0.08 -> 0.15
NER-f1: 0.74 -> 0.71
```
(older model is synth-spanish-v1 -> new is v2 q4-quant)

Sasha: sounds like tokenization drift. Did the onboarding script switch to `sentencepiece` presets? v1 used sacremoses tokenization in preprocessing.

Maya: onboarding used the repo default (sentencepiece). That might explain differences for punctuation-heavy examples.

Oliver: I can do a quick smoke: re-run staging eval with sacremoses tokenization to confirm. Give me folder path for promptset.

Maya: added promptset under `gs://redwood-onboard/synth-es/v2/prompt-sets/round1.jsonl` and pinned the model in staging config to `synth-spanish-v2:q4`.

Taylor: heads up infra: `eval-bot` will restart infra worker pool at 02:00 UTC for node update — staging evals might be flaky for ~10m. If you want a clean run, start before 01:45 UTC.

eval-bot: scheduled restart: nodepool-staging-3 in 2h.

Jon: also pinging for code review — PR 1123 touches prompt-normalizer and could affect canonicalization. Left two small comments about preserving trailing whitespace in prompts.

Maya: thanks — I'll address the two nits and re-run the onboarding pipeline after Oliver's tokenization check.

Sasha: if we confirm tokenization is the cause, we should add a small regression test: run on a 200-sample punctuation-heavy subset and ensure BLEU delta <= 1.5.

Oliver: running sacremoses-tokenized eval now (kickoff). Will post short logs here.

Oliver: log snippet:
```
run_id: token-check-1745800022
result: BLEU 12.1 (close to v1)
hallucination_rate: 0.09
```

Maya: OK results point to tokenizer mismatch. Blocker: need to decide whether to convert onboarding to sacremoses or to normalize prompts to be sentencepiece-friendly.

Jon: my vote: normalize prompts at ingest (safer long-term). Quick patch to prompt-normalizer to strip weird unicode and apply controlled tokenization mapping. If Maya is good with the change, I can open PR today.

Maya: go ahead, Jon. If you add the regression test Sasha suggested, I'll feel better merging.

Oliver: I'll validate after Jon's PR and then run a full staging eval. Expect to close blocker by EOD if no surprises.

Taylor: noted — I'll postpone the nodepool restart by 1h so the final eval doesn't overlap.

Maya: thanks everyone — will update the onboarding checklist with the tokenization note and mark this as in-progress. If anyone wants to pair on the normalizer PR, ping me. :thumbsup:
